name: com.findmybids/findmybids
title: FindMyBids
description: Open US government bids for small businesses: federal, state and local, with eligibility checks.

tools.name: search_bids
tools.description:
Search open bids (government contracts and RFPs) that FindMyBids tracks.

    query: keywords, e.g. "roof repair", "janitorial", "IT help desk". Commas mean OR: "roofing, gutters".
    states: two-letter codes where the work is, e.g. ["PA", "MD"].
    level: "federal", "state", "local" or "private" (private = bids private companies posted on FindMyBids, plus
    invitations the signed-in user saved).
    naics: NAICS code prefixes, e.g. ["5617", "238"].
    set_aside: text to match, e.g. "Small Business", "8(a)", "HUBZone", "WOSB", "SDVOSB".
    due_after: ISO date; defaults to today (only bids still open).

query.title: Query
query.description: Keywords for the work, e.g. "roof repair", "janitorial". Commas mean OR: "roofing, gutters".

states.title: States
states.description: Two-letter state codes where the work is, e.g. ["PA", "MD"].

level.title: Level
level.description: "federal", "state", "local" or "private" (bids private companies posted on FindMyBids, plus invitations the signed-in user saved).

set_aside.title: Set Aside
set_aside.description: Set-aside text to match, e.g. "Small Business", "8(a)", "HUBZone", "WOSB", "SDVOSB".

due_after.title: Due After
due_after.description: ISO date (YYYY-MM-DD). Defaults to today, so only bids still open come back.

tools.name: get_bid
tools.description:
Details for one bid. bid_id: a FindMyBids bid ID, e.g. "nj:27DPP01349". include_text=true also reads the
    bid page and main document and returns an excerpt.

bid_id.title: Bid Id
bid_id.description: A FindMyBids bid ID from search_bids or get_my_bids, e.g. "nj:27DPP01349".

include_text.title: Include Text
include_text.description: True also reads the official bid page and main document and returns an excerpt.

tools.name: get_my_bids
tools.description:
Open bids that match the user's saved FindMyBids alerts (the same list as My bids on findmybids.com),
    soonest deadline first. new_since_days: only bids posted in the last N days (e.g. 1 for today's new bids).

new_since_days.title: New Since Days
new_since_days.description: Only bids posted in the last N days, e.g. 1 for today's new bids. Leave out for all open matches.

tools.name: check_readiness
tools.description:
Check whether the user's business (their FindMyBids business profile) is ready to bid.

    Give ONE of: bid_id (a FindMyBids bid ID), url (link to any bid page or PDF, any state or private client),
    or text (pasted bid text). For url/text, also pass state (two letters), level ("federal"/"state"/"local"/
    "private") and due_date (ISO) if known.
    Returns a verdict, each requirement with status gap / check / ready / info, the sentence it came from,
    walkthrough links for registration gaps, and an excerpt of the bid to confirm against.
    Free accounts get 3 checks a month (shared with the website); Pro is unlimited.

bid_id.title: Bid Id
bid_id.description: A FindMyBids bid ID. Give one of bid_id, url or text.

url.title: Url
url.description: Link to any bid page or PDF (any state or private client). Give one of bid_id, url or text.

text.title: Text
text.description: Pasted bid text. Give one of bid_id, url or text.

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code of the bid, for url or text.

due_date.title: Due Date
due_date.description: Due date (YYYY-MM-DD) if known, for url or text.

title.title: Title
title.description: Bid title if known, for url or text.

tools.name: get_walkthrough
tools.description:
Step-by-step registration guide. portal: a state code or name ("PA", "Ohio"), "sam" for SAM.gov,
    or "us-sba-certifications" for SBA set-aside certifications. Also returns bid_forms: the standard affidavits,
    certifications, bonds and diversity forms bidders are commonly asked for there, with links to the official blank forms.

portal.title: Portal
portal.description: A state code or name ("PA", "Ohio"), "sam" for SAM.gov, or "us-sba-certifications" for SBA set-aside certifications. list_walkthroughs shows every option.

tools.name: list_walkthroughs
tools.description: All registration guides: SAM.gov, SBA certifications, and all 50 states.

tools.name: get_profile
tools.description:
The user's saved business profile used by check_readiness (same as findmybids.com/account/business),
    plus the template of fields it understands.

tools.name: save_profile
tools.description:
Save or update the user's business profile (merged into what's saved).
    Fields: company_name, home_state, naics (list), certifications (list), registrations ({"SAM": {"status":
    "active", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}, "PA": {"status": "active"}}), insurance (dollar limits), bonding,
    licenses, states_qualified.

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: Fields to save, merged into the saved profile: company_name, home_state, naics (list), certifications (list), registrations ({"SAM": {"status": "active", "expires": "YYYY-MM-DD"}}), insurance (dollar limits), bonding, licenses, states_qualified.

tools.name: add_private_bid
tools.description:
Save a private bid invitation the user received (from a general contractor, property owner, or any
    company) so it shows up in their own searches alongside public bids. Only the user can see it.
    Paste the invite text or give its link.

text.title: Text
text.description: The invitation text, pasted. Give text or url.

url.title: Url
url.description: Link to the invitation or its documents. Give text or url.

agency.title: Agency
agency.description: Who sent it (general contractor, property owner or company).

state.title: State
state.description: Two-letter state code where the work is.

tools.name: save_alert
tools.description: Save a bid search as the signed-in user's FindMyBids alert. New open bids that match it are emailed to the user and listed by get_my_bids. This saves to the user's account: call it only after the user confirms the keywords and states.

keywords.description: What the user's business does, comma-separated, e.g. "janitorial, floor care".
keywords.title: Keywords

states.description: Two-letter US state codes where the user wants work, e.g. ["TX"].
states.title: States

tools.name: sources_status
tools.description: When each bid source last updated and whether it worked.
